Traffic Advisory

Due to repair work at the Azad Market Railway Underpass (RUB) on Ram Bagh Road/Vir Banda Bairagi Marg, traffic movement in the area will remain affected.

The stretch from Azad Market Chowk to the Railway Underpass will remain completely closed for vehicular traffic from 10:00 PM on 30.05.2026 to 05:00 AM on 01.06.2026.

From 01.06.2026 to 10.06.2026, traffic diversions will be enforced daily between 09:00 PM and 05:00 AM to facilitate repair work.

Commuters are advised to plan their journeys in advance, use alternate routes, and follow the directions of traffic police personnel deployed on duty. Your cooperation will help ensure smooth traffic management.

#DTPUpdates
